hero.title: Youth-led transparency for Kenya's budget
hero.body: Budget Ndio Story transforms how Kenyans understand national and county budgets  --  turning complex fiscal documents into stories, data, and training people actually use.
hero.imageAlt: Budget Ndio Story team and partners in a stakeholder session

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Every young Kenyan has the right to understand how public money is spent. We break down The Budget  and related fiscal documents into digestible content  --  so a new generation can hold leaders accountable and participate meaningfully in governance.

photoStrip.alt: Budget Ndio Story community and civic engagement

openCall.title: Open call: young creatives wanted (18–34)
openCall.body: Space for young creators who care about civic storytelling and public accountability. If you are ready to shape how Kenya talks about budgets, join our creative network.
